It self-animates from a start time and duration, and the animated textures may be independently configured. Cooldowns are usually children of another frame and set to . The stock UI uses this widget with to display ability cooldowns on action buttons or buff/debuff durations on unit frames.

The Umbrafen tribe, one of the three Lost One tribes of Zangarmarsh, is the worst of all the traitor tribes of Broken and Lost Ones. They are allied with Illidan's Naga and use dark magic to trap and enslave others to serve them. They are led by Kataru. They are named after Umbrafen, a Zangar forest that was once located on the northern coastline of Shadowmoon Valley before its destruction.

Ugrul Skullcleaver is a Frostcrag drogbar found inside a cave at the Highmountain Summit in Highmountain.
Umbric's Notes - Sanctum of the Moon can be found in the Sanctum of the Moon in the Ghostlands
Umbric's Notes - Dawnstar Spire can be found in the Dawnstar Spire in the Ghostlands

Umbral Moonglaives drops from the Sisters of the Moon in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Una Ji'ro was a jungle troll of the Shatterspear tribe found in Shatterspear Vale in Classic. Her fate after the night elf assault on the village is unknown.
Unattended Cannons are devastators in the Black City area of the Broken Shore. They can be stolen by adventurers and used against the Burning Legion.

Un'gol Ruins is an Island Expedition in Battle for Azeroth. It is a tropical island with ogre ruins. It is inhabited by hozen, pygmies, and quilboar. Gorlocs, troggs, kobolds, saurok and naga can also be found here.

Unburden was the Kyrian Covenant signature ability shown at BlizzCon 2019. It was replaced with Summon Steward by April 2020. Though it was removed as an active ability, this spell's effect survives as a buff tied to the Kyrian Covenant Transport Network.

The Uncharted Isle is an island located deep into uncharted seas. The Fluctuating Worldvein is recovered from here via a long expedition. The location of the island is found with the Resonance Locator from the Uldir facility.

Uncommon (sometimes called good or magic) is the level of item quality in between and . * The names of Uncommon quality items will appear in green. * Uncommon quality items are sometimes referred to as "Greens." * Equippable items of Uncommon quality usually have one or more attribute bonuses. * Most equippable items at Uncommon quality and above can be disenchanted by characters with the Enchanting profession. * Some ingredient items are of Uncommon quality, including all Essences used in the Enchanting profession, such as Greater Eternal Essence, Elemental Essences, such as Essence of Fire, Living Essence, Essence of Air etc., and other specific ingredients, such as Blood of the Mountain.

Undercity Guardians are max level guards found throughout the Undercity and provide directions to various locations in town. They were provided skinning hooks by Killian Hagey who also taught them how to skin.
Undercity Commendation Officer was a Forsaken quest giver located in the Valley of Spirits in the orcish city of Orgrimmar, who was only available during the Ahn'Qiraj War Effort world event.
Undercity Gift of Friendship is a 60 minute +30 intellect buff gained after creating an from the three Undercity pledge item packages during the Love is in the Air event.
Undercity Valiants are the valiant challengers of the Horde faction Undercity.

Underwater walking is a movement mechanism originally introduced in that allows the character to function as if he/she is on land when standing or walking on the seafloor. This includes water breathing, the ability to eat or drink while on the seafloor, the ability to mount on the seafloor, and increased movement speed while not mounted and walking on the seafloor.
Undercity Citizens are Forsaken in the Ruins of Lordaeron above the Undercity. Many of them gather into small groups and chat, while others drink wine or sit and read scrolls.

Undercity Cockroach teaches you how to summon a companion of the same name. As NPCs, they can be found next to Jeremiah Payson in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity, as well as on the Gates of Orgrimmar. After the cleansing of Ruins of Lordaeron, they can be found there as well.

Underlight Angler is an artifact fishing pole. Crafted by Marcia Chase, the rod is made from the head lure of the deep sea murloc Mglrrp, which apparently gives the rod its power, and the body of the rod is made from Mglrrp's skeleton. Unlike the other Legion artifacts, the Underlight Angler's power was not sacrificed to draw out the darkness from the Sword of Sargeras to stabilize Azeroth's wounds, and thus it is usable in Battle for Azeroth and beyond.

Undercity Aristocrats are Forsaken attending Mistress Matilda's party on the terrace above the Rogues' Quarter in Undercity. They are mingling and drinking in groups of two to four, mostly around tables.
Undercity Evacuees are Forsaken being evacuated from the Undercity into Orgrimmar.
Undercity Fireeaters were Forsaken located in the Undercity. They were replaced by Master Flame Eaters.
Undisturbed Eggs are aqir eggs located at the Obelisk of the Moon in Uldum during the Assault in Uldum. Destroying the eggs will cause five Sandstone Hatchlings to burst forth.
__NOTOC__ Undercity Elite Guardians are abominations found in the Undercity during the Scourge Invasion.

Undying Resolve is the name of a permanent buff granted to all Death Knights during their time in The Scarlet Enclave. It allows the death knight to, with the aid of a Val'kyr Battle-maiden, resurrect upon death (with full health) where his or her corpse lays. Note that the Death Knight still suffers a durability penalty, and that he can only be resurrected in such a manner once every ten minutes. If the Death Knight dies more than once in a ten-minute period, then his spirit will spawn at a nearby graveyard, and he will have the choice as usual either to walk to his corpse or to suffer a higher durability loss and ten minutes of Resurrection Sickness.

Unity Square is a large plaza located on the south side of the Kul Tiran capital city of Boralus. Sitting just off Proudmoore Keep, the square celebrates the unity of the kingdom's four ruling houses: Proudmoore, Ashvane, Waycrest, and Stormsong. At its center stands a large statue and memorial to Daelin Proudmoore, the late Lord Admiral of Kul Tiras, constructed following his death at Theramore. The square and its surrounding spaces serves as a major meeting place in the city, as well as a location for important ceremonies and addresses.

The Unknown Crypt is a mogu crypt located beneath the islands traveled on Island Expeditions. It is accessed through the Spirit Gateway. The following mogu are found here: *Jun-Ti *Soul-Bringer Togan *Stone Machinist Nu-Xin *Tumat

Unlucky Fish is a goldfish that appears in a small mass of water with Khadgar during The Battle of the Forge after he destroyed the dam in Blackrock Quarry in Tanaan Jungle during Assault on the Dark Portal and teleported on the ground. The fish then flipped itself to the water.

Unholy Nova is the priest class ability of the Necrolord Covenant. It's available to all priests who join the Necrolords. This ability is also temporarily available during the Maldraxxus portion of the Shadowlands campaign; it's given by the quest Champion the Cause and lasts until you finish the Maldraxxus storyline.

Unlocking Magical Treasures is the unlock quest for Magic-Bound Chests in the Dragon Isles. It becomes available at Renown level 16 with the Dragonscale Expedition.

Unstable Flask of the Sorcerer is a flask that boosts intellect, stamina and spell damage and healing for 1 hour. The effect persists through death. The flask is only effective in the plateau areas of Blade's Edge Mountains (the areas only reachable with a flying mount), and in Gruul's Lair. It can be created at the Bash'ir Crystalforge at Bash'ir Landing using 10 Apexis Shard. There are 6 Unstable Flasks available.
Unrelenting Storm is a talent to increase your mana regeneration. It is useful that the regeneration stays intact while casting.

Unstable Powerful Truesteel Essences are what remains of Powerful Truesteel Essences, which can no longer be crafted. Prior to Shadowlands, using this item "restored" it into a Truesteel Essence and 25 Sorcerous Air.

Unstable Powerful Burnished Essences are what remains of Powerful Burnished Essences, which can no longer be crafted. Prior to Shadowlands, using this item "restored" it into a Burnished Essence and 25 Sorcerous Water.
The Unstoppable Countdown Clock drops from mobs on Mechagon Island.
The Unprepared Star Chart could be turned into a Partial Star Chart with Medivh's Telescope.

Unstable Powerful Ensorcelled Tarots are what remains of Powerful Ensorcelled Tarots, which can no longer be crafted. Prior to Shadowlands, using this item "restored" it into an Ensorcelled Tarot and 25 Sorcerous Fire.

The unnamed world-soul was a nascent titan spirit that was discovered by Sargeras while he was still a champion of the Pantheon. The slumbering titan was shrouded in Void energy and being corrupted by Old Gods which led to Sargeras destroying it, in order to prevent the birth of a dark titan that would end the universe. This event caused a schism within the Pantheon and ultimately led to Sargeras leaving them to begin the Burning Crusade.

After being claimed by the Scourge, it was instead used to store the remains of Kel'Thuzad.
Ursine Adept is a Guardian druid ability. It enables the use of Moonfire, Rebirth, Remove Corruption and Soothe in Bear Form.

The Vale of Eternal Blossoms is a region at the center of the continent of Pandaria, and has great cultural importance to both the pandaren and mogu, particularly due to the Mogu'shan Palace. Formerly known as a Cradle of Life and used as a place of experimentation by the titans similar to Sholazar Basin and Un'Goro Crater, this vale of golden flowers and trees served as the seat of power for the rulers of Pandaria, such as the mogu rulers following the death of Lei Shen. After the Alliance and Horde came to Pandaria bringing their war with them, the August Celestials decided to reopen the gate after sealing it following the downfall of the mogu empire. Vagrants are homeless people in the Lower City of the neutral Shattrath City.

The Valdrakken Accord is a draconic organization led by the Dragon Aspects to represent the reunification of the dragonkin upon their home of the Dragon Isles. A spiritual successor to the Wyrmrest Accord, the Valdrakken Accord takes its name from the mighty draconic city of Valdrakken, upon which at the Seat of the Aspects the Dragon Aspects lead their people. Unlike the Wyrmrest Accord, the Valdrakken Accord contains representatives of all five flights, and is led by the five Dragon Aspects, Alexstrasza, Nozdormu, Kalecgos, Merithra, and Ebyssian; the latter of whom was appointed by the accord themselves at the behest of his brothers, Wrathion and Sabellian.
Valdrakken Flightmages are blue dragonspawn maintaining the portal to Valdrakken in Pathfinder's Den in Orgrimmar and in Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind City.

The Valley of Kings is located in the southwestern corner of the dwarven territory of Loch Modan, just west of Stonesplinter Valley. When going to or from Dun Morogh by the South Gate Pass, adventurers pass through a piece of this verdant valley, which also is an important throughway to the dangerous region known as the Searing Gorge. The gate to the gorge remains under lock and guard, and adventurers have to prove their power to Mountaineer Pebblebitty before she will grant them full access through the gate. The Valley of Honor is the location for all things having to do with warfare in Orgrimmar. The valley is home to both warrior and hunter trainers, various arms and armor vendors, and the Horde battlemasters. The Ring of Valor arena is located here. The Hall of the Brave houses the warrior guild, as well as all the city's battlemasters. Blacksmithing, mining, and fishing trainers and vendors are found in the valley. During the second Scourge Invasion, the valley was invaded by the Scourge. It was defended by Horde champions and leaders. The Cataclysm has caused the land to shift in the valley. The Valley of Wisdom was once the location of Grommash Hold, where Warchief Thrall once resided in Orgrimmar. When the Cataclysm stuck much of the area changed as the land sunk in some places creating spots for pools to form. A few remains of Grommash Hold can still be seen where the tauren were allowed to set up huts and take this valley for their own use. The armor of pit lord Mannoroth, which once rested on a tree here is now gone and the tree was destroyed. The valley connects to the Drag in the east, the Valley of Spirits to the west and the Cleft of Shadow and Valley of Strength to the south. The Valley of Dulvarinn is located in the Moonglade. It is known for its variety of herbs and plants which have a variety of uses, from nigh-indestructible thread to healing balms. It is from a ley line pattern in this valley that the Restoration Pattern is derived.

The Valley of Ashes is an area in the Burning Steppes. It is a smoldering stretch of valley curving between the hills, with molten flows to the south and a charred plain to the north. Nothing but tough local wildlife lives here; the only sentient creatures in the area are the black dragonflight. The valley is surrounded by inhospitable land, as Dreadmaul Rock lies to the northeast, the Ruins of Thaurissan is to the northwest, and the Blackrock clan's Black Tooth Hovel is west. The road running south through the valley leads through Blackrock Pass and eventually into the Redridge Mountains.

__NOTOC__ The Valley of Sorrows is a gloomy canyon in southern Vol'dun, just east of Zul'Ahjin and north of Redrock Mesa. It is here that Akunda stores the painful memories he removes from his followers at the nearby Temple of Akunda. The loa's power normally keeps the memories sealed away, but recently they have been released from their magical confines and their physical manifestations now roam the valley. As a result, the canyon has become highly dangerous, and not even the sethrak step foot in it.

The Vale of Eternal Twilight is a constructed realm created by N'Zoth as a corrupted form of the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. In this vision, the Horde forces at the Shrine of Two Moons have fallen completely to the whispers of N'Zoth. Now an army of mindless thralls, they attacked the Alliance forces at the Shrine of Seven Stars. With even those at the Alliance shrine beginning to fall to madness, those who remain sane ended up in a battle on two fronts. Go to the Blacktalon Agent in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms to get in.
Valero Needs Help! is a bonus objective on Island Expeditions. Its objective differs depending on the island.

Like their Southern Kalimdor siblings, the magical beasts called vampire bats of Zul'Aman have always savored the frenzied turmoil of battle. This chaotic disposition has naturally aligned them with the Forsaken, who continue their struggle against the Lich King's Scourge while maintaining a tense alliance with the Horde. In addition to ferrying those who pay for their service throughout Lordaeron, the vampire bats also act as scouts for the Dark Lady. Vampire bats have been trained as scouts and mounts by the Forsaken of the Undercity and the Amani trolls of Zul'Aman.

Var'gazul was a jungle troll who served as chief of the Gurubashi Empire. As is told in the Fall of Gurubashi, Var'gazul prepared "plans of conquest" with the help of Min'loth and his witch doctors. It is unknown who was the enemy of the Empire at the time. For some reasons, either the plans of conquest, or the water magic used by Min'loth, caused the wrath of Neptulon to come upon an unsuspecting Empire. The waters of the Great Sea, and the Krakken monsters destroyed all the land west of Zul'Gurub. As the waters receded, the Empire was no more.

.]] Vampiric Touch is a level 10 Shadow priest ability. It deals shadow damage over 21 seconds, heals the priest for a portion of the damage, and generates Insanity when cast. Vampiric Touch is one of the shadow priest's damage over time effects, and is a key shadow ability due to its interactions with Mastery: Shadow Weaving and Shadowy Apparitions. Additionally, Vampiric Touch is one of the few periodic damaging effects that features built in dispel protection, immediately horrifying the dispeller when dispelled.

The Vault of the Shadowflame comprises the bulk of Blackwing Descent. It consists of a circular chamber which branches off into several wings, where Chimaeron, Atramedes, and Maloriak can be found. Additionally, this is where Nefarian raises Onyxia from the dead. The main area forms a ring around a pit of lava, with members of the black dragonflight found throughout the room. The carcasses of members of other dragonflights adorn the ceiling. Once the other bosses have been defeated, Lord Victor Nefarius can be found in the middle of the chamber. The Veiled Stair is a mysterious region of Pandaria, located in the mountains between The Jade Forest, Valley of the Four Winds and Vale of Eternal Blossoms. The stair ultimately connects Valley of the Four Winds to Kun-Lai Summit via mountain passes and cave networks. The stair begins with the Path of a Hundred Steps in the Grassy Cline of the Valley of the Four Winds, which leads up to the Tavern in the Mists. Behind the tavern, the path continues, forking in three directions. Veiled Witnesses are humans briefly appearing at Altar of Storms in Blasted Lands, and in Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City.
Veiled Witnesses are humans briefly appearing at Altar of Storms in Blasted Lands, in Raven Hill in Duskwood, and in Stormwind City.

The Vault of Mirrors is found on the second floor of the Vault of the Wardens. Glazer has broken free of its confines, rendered invulnerable due to its abilities. Demon hunters race to re-engage the mirrors that held it in check.

__NOTOC__ Veilwings (also called feathered drakes or feathered dragons) are feathered dragonkin native to Ardenweald. No creature in Ardenweald is more respected for its fierce defense of its family or territory than the graceful and dangerous veilwings. They can breathe charged anima at their enemies, either in a cone like how Azerothian dragons breathe fire, or by spitting it out in bolts. The latter allow the night fae to effectively use them as anti-air cannons. Veilwing hearts are sources of great magical power and are especially useful in necromantic rituals.

Vaskarn is a dracthyr located with Cuzolth in Loamm in Zaralek Cavern. She introduces adventurers to the Dragonflight Season 2 item upgrade path for non-PvP items using Flightstones. She and Cuzolth then moved to Central Encampment under Amirdrassil in the Emerald Dream.

__NOTOC__ Vendellin Soulfire was a powerful blood elf warlock paid by Katrana Prestor to find and kill King Varian Wrynn. He flew with his dragonhawk mount to the Wetlands and found Varian, accompanied by Broll Bearmantle, Valeera Sanguinar, and Thargas Anvilmar. He cast the Mark of Kathra'natir, a powerful corrupting curse, upon Valeera, then summoned a huge doomguard to fight Broll and Thargas while he battled Varian himself. Eventually, his doomguard was torn apart by Broll's roots and Vendellin was beheaded by Varian. Valeera's curse would worsen over time, with fel runes growing on her body.
__NOTOC__ Vengeance Point is a small island off the northwestern coast of the Broken Shore. A flightpath can be found there.
The Venture Co. Copter Pad can be found near Cragpool Lake in Stonetalon Mountains. At least a bomber-looking flying machine can be found there.
Venture Oafs are hobgoblins who can be encountered during Island Expeditions. They also briefly appear at the Waterspring Field in Tanaris.

The venthyr of Revendreth are vampiric punishers of the unworthy, charged with rehabilitating the sinful souls sent to them by the Arbiter. Souls who are successfully rehabilitated can then choose to be sent to another realm to serve for eternity, or become a venthyr themselves and continue the cycle as an instrument of repentance. The venthyr were created by Sire Denathrius in his own likeness. The first of them, Prince Renathal, and other members of the original Court of Harvesters such as the Curator and the first Harvester of Wrath were willed into being by Denathrius. Later venthyr—the first of which was the Stonewright—were (and are) created from redeemed souls who are given a new name
Verdant Gladiator's Slitherdrake is a feat of strength achievement earned by obtaining the Verdant Gladiator's Slitherdrake from Dragonflight Season 2.

The high elf Veth'talia the fighting sorceress was known as much for her combat abilities as her mastery of the arcane arts. She created several special items to aid her career as a fighting spellcaster. One of these items was a special vial made of virtually unbreakable glass, filled with a clear liquid, the Enchanted Vial of Veth'talia. It could magically fill with a blue or red elixir (the blue elixir would replace mana, and the red elixir heal wounds). Another of the items created by the high elf Veth'talia during her career as a fighting spellcaster was the, Jade Ring of Veth'talia, made of purest jade (it causes the wearer's eyes to change to a deep, rich, almost glittering green.). Vesthra's Power Stone is located in at Ravencrest Monument in Azshara. It is empowering Lady Vesthra.
__NOTOC__ Vestar of the Tattered Sail is a kvaldir located in Island Expeditions.

Vesper Totem is the shaman class ability of the Kyrian Covenant. It's available to all shamans who join the Kyrian. This ability is also temporarily available during the Bastion portion of the Shadowlands campaign; it's given by the quest The Archon's Answer and lasts until you finish the Bastion storyline.

Victor Ward is a Forsaken located in the Magic Quarter in the Undercity.
Viggz Shinesparked is a goblin engineering vendor located in the Lower City in Shattrath City.

Victor Bartholomew is Forsaken in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity. Alongside Adrian Bartlett and Winifred Kerwin, he's attending at a lesson about demons by Jezelle Pruitt. Despite being probably a warlock, he has no mana points.

Vieron Blazefeather is a blood elf quest giver serving the Horde in Wintergrasp. He is located in Wintergrasp Fortress whenever the Horde controls the fortress. Otherwise, he is found at the Warsong camp outside Wintergrasp Fortress. Vieron's mission is to arm the Warsong Offensive's archers with arrows in Northrend. He is not particularly pleased with his dreary role in the Wintergrasp conflict, and is of the opinion that he should have remained in Silvermoon City with his brother. He is also apparently a poet.
Vicious Streak is an ability used by Darkmoon Rabbit during a Pet Battle.

__NOTOC__ Vindicator Xayann is a draenei located at the Shattered Sun Staging Area on the Isle of Quel'Danas. She offers a repeatable daily quest to overwrite the control of the Arcane Guardians that wander the island.

The Violet Gardens were an area in Dalaran. They were as saturated with magic as everything else in the city. Jaina Proudmoore never saw healthier, more colorful flowers, or eaten more delicious fruits, like goldenbark apples, and vegetables than here. She would come here and relax, sometimes accompanied with Kael'thas Sunstrider, who courted her. On an occasion, when Prince Arthas visited Dalaran, he found Jaina in the gardens. Later, they had a picnic here. During the Third War, it was there that the prophet Medivh met with Antonidas in order to convince him of the impending demon threat. The Violet Rise is the Kirin Tor Offensive toehold on a small island off to the southeast of the Isle of Thunder. After claiming Shaol'mara (and phasing in the Violet Rise), adventurers of the Alliance wishing to help the Kirin Tor Offensive claim the isle can teleport here from the Alliance camp at north of the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes. Surrounded by the Whispering Inlet, to the west are the Shadewood Thicket and Diremoor, and Ihgaluk Crag is to the southwest. The Kirin Tor Beacon can be used to return Alliance players directly to the Violet Rise every ten minutes, but it can only be used on the Isle of Thunder. __NOTOC__ Vineyard Laborers are nightborne located in Suramar City in Suramar. Following the city's liberation from the Burning Legion, one laborer is seen entering the Nighthold district with two barrels and going to Sylverin where he places the barrels and returns to leave the Nighthold.
Vindicaar Matrix Crystal is the placeholder ability for the abilities from the Vindicaar Matrix Core when not currently on Argus. It does nothing when clicked.

The Violet Council was Dalaran's elite council of nine which tried to hold back the forces of the Scourge during Arthas' siege of the city during the Third War. It was composed of nine Council Wizards. They summoned reinforcements to fight the undead and protected magical vaults holding either treasures or Dalaran experiments.

Visitor centers are areas, usually buildings, found in major cities that help people learn about that particular city. It is often the place where you can find a guildmaster from whom you purchase a guild charter and tabard. The visitor center is usually near the main entrance to the city, though this is not always the case.

Vitus Darkwalker is a warlock trainer first encountered by worgen players at the Military District and Greymane Court in Gilneas City. He can later be found at Duskhaven and other various locations in Gilneas and finally at the Howling Oak in Darnassus. After Vitus began his training and began to become accomplished, a being named Balcephoth taught him the forbidden secrets of :Corruption. During the Burning of Teldrassil, he was seemingly evacuated with the civilians to Stormwind City.
Vivid Visions - Fortunes and Fates is a shop located in the Evermoon Commons of Suramar City in Suramar.

Vivacity of Collaboration is an item which hold thirty five anima power, the player is able to infuse the anima into the covenant's reservoir. This item can be obtain by random Battlegrounds and other pvp activities, In addition it can also be obtained by doing PVE activities such as random Dungeons
Vizio Needs Help! is a bonus objective on Island Expeditions. Its objective differs depending on the island.

The Violetsail are a group of pirates and pet poachers led by Trainer Iris Greedsway and operating in the Eye of Azshara. They hired several onlookers to spy on Breanni's Magical Menagerie. Flying above the Eye of Azshara, they shot down Zantini, distribution manager of supplies and pets, and stole several pets, including Gurgl.

Voidbinder Sturzah is an ethereal item upgrader located in the canal area of Stormwind City. He can be found in the shop where he works, The Three Winds, alongside fellow ethereal Warpweaver Hashom, Vaultkeeper Razhid, and Thaumaturge Rafir. Void Warlocks were blood elves that followed Magister Umbric into exile from Silvermoon City and Quel'Thalas for dealing with the Void. Umbric's outcasts would eventually reach Telogrus Rift, whereupon they were attacked by Nether-Prince Durzaan. Though Durzaan was defeated, the gathered blood elves had been transformed into some of the first void elves. Accepting their new forms, they pledged their allegiance to their savior Alleria Windrunner and the Grand Alliance.

Void-Twisted Whelps are twilight whelps found at the Vermillion Redoubt in the Twilight Highlands during In the Shadow of Crimson Wings. In Stage 1 of the scenario, they hatch from destroyed Dragon Eggs, though they die shortly after. In later stages, they can be seen flying around on their own.
Voriya was a level 56 female jungle troll found in the Shatterspear Vale in Classic. She was part of the Shatterspear tribe. Her fate after the night elf assault on the village is unknown.

Vordrassil, meaning "Broken Crown" in Darnassian, are the remains of a World Tree located in the Grizzly Hills of southern Northrend. Originally called Andrassil, meaning the "Crown of the Snow", it was grown from a branch taken from Nordrassil by Fandral Staghelm and his druids in order to stop the spread of saronite in the northern continent. Without the blessings of the Aspects however, it was vulnerable to the Old Gods' corruption. The ancient druids were forced to fell the tree, which they renamed Vordrassil. Volcanic (formerly Firestorm) is a multi-school of magic, combining the Fire and Nature schools. Multi-school abilities benefit from bonuses that affect any of their schools, use the lowest resistance value among their schools, ignore absorption and immunity effects that apply to only some of their schools, and can be used even when one or more of their schools have been locked with an interrupt effect.

Volunteer City Guard is a buff you get during Volunteer Guard Day. You have to kill 10 City Invaders in order to get Defender of Stormwind, Defender of Ironforge, Defender of The Exodar, Defender of Darnassus.
Voru'kar Flyers are nerubian flyers located on the expedition isles.
The Volatile Devastator Round is a quest reward from Overwhelming Power (quest).

Vulpin are fox-like creatures native to the Shadowlands that can be found in Ardenweald and Bastion. Vulpin are very elusive: one may journey in Bastion for millennia before they encounter vulpin in the wild. Although they are predators, instead of the largest fangs or claws, they employ stealth and cunning when hunting. This also makes it quite difficult to hunt one. Vulpin are able to use anima to bolster these abilities, allowing them to reinforce their fur, increase their speed, and even veil themselves completely from sight. Their flowing tails are very valued for alchemical pursuits. Vulpin can instantly teleport between the realms of the Shadowlands.

Walter Soref is a Forsaken located in the Rogues' Quarter of the Undercity. He gives back keys you have destroyed that you cannot get back through redoing quests, like the Skeleton Key for Scholomance. He is also found in the Hall of Shadows. After the Forsaken reclaimed the Ruins of Lordaeron, Walter moved there.

WHEE! is a reputation and experience gain bonus that is available only during the Darkmoon Faire World Event. To acquire the buff, players ride the Darkmoon Carousel on the western side of the Faire, which "stacks" the buff in 5 minute duration increments up to a 60 minute maximum (though even the first application grants the full 10% bonus). Tickets are required to enter the carousel area, but are sold very cheaply by the nearby Kae Ti.
The Wand of Dispelling would have been provided as an objective for Unchecked Power. Instead the powers of the wand are simply used from an extra button available during the quest.
The Wailing Halls link the Terrace of the Moon to the Befouled Sanctum. Destroyed sections have ghostly afterimages of their intact states.

Walton Cogfrenzy is a Mechagon mechagnome located in Rustbolt on Mechagon Island. He is secretly a member of the Rustbolt Resistance, sneaking refugees and resisters to Rustbolt whenever possible. He ultimately survives the rebellion and goes on to continue serving his people. He can be seen with Pascal-K1N6 near one of the city's forges when a new Mechagon mechagnome is created; though he cannot be actually found over there by the time the player is able to control their new character.

Wagonmaster Derawyn is a sylvar located in Ardenweald. She is first seen when Te'zan asks an adventurer for help, as starving wildlife attacks her caravan of spirits. She then traveled to Heartwood Grove, which was attacked by possessed fae and Drust, and was gravely wounded in the attack. Her friend Niya wished to use the power within the animacones they found to revive her, but Derawyn refused, claiming that the power within must be preserved for the wildseeds. She dies as Niya weeps, saying that the cycle must continue.

The War Quarter is located in the northwest corner of the Undercity. The Warcraft: War of the Ancients Archive is a book of the War of the Ancients Trilogy. It was published on December 11, 2007 by Pocket Star Books. Armies of satyrs attacked the night elves with the intent of destroying their civilization. At least part of the war was fought on Ashenvale. The satyrs were helped by demons that had somehow lingered on Azeroth after the defeat of the Burning Legion. The night elves were directed by Malfurion Stormrage, Tyrande Whisperwind, and Shandris Feathermoon. The night elves Ralaar Fangfire, Belysra and Arvell fought in the war. The Wandering Isle is the starting area of the playable pandaren in World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria. The Isle is a massive island on the back of a giant turtle, known to the pandaren as Shen-zin Su, and inhabited by curious pandaren and/or their descendants who left their homeland of Pandaria centuries after the Great Sundering in order to discover the other lands and races of Azeroth; The Isle has been weaving about the world's oceans ever since. After the destruction of the Peak of Serenity in Pandaria, the monks of the Order of the Broken Temple relocated to the Wandering Isle.

Players who acquire this mount also earn the Alliance equivalent, the Smoldering Reins of the Teldrassil Hippogryph.

The war between the Lightbound and the Mag'har was fought on after the Lightbound draenei led by High Exarch Yrel decided to unite the planet and bring order to the universe, fighting against the led by . Many orcs and ogres joined willingly, while others were forced.

Warchief's Heralds are orcs found by the Warchief's Command Board in every capital city of the Horde and starting zones. After the failed Broken Shore attack, the one in the Valley of Strength turned to face High Overlord Saurfang and later Urtrun Clanbringer. After the Warchief's death, the one standing in the Valley of Honor was seen speaking with an Orgrimmar Grunt.

Warcraft: Durotan is a novel by Christie Golden, intended as a prequel to the Warcraft film. The book explains the situation on Draenor prior to the invasion of Azeroth, with Durotan as the main character. Set in the film universe, the novel is not a new version of Rise of the Horde, although it does cover some of the equivalent events in the film universe.
Warbrave Oro is a Highmountain tauren warbrave of the Highmountain Tribe.

Warbrave Nava is a Highmountain tauren warbrave and quest giver standing at the northern end of the bridge connecting Thunder Totem to the Crystal Fissure in Highmountain. He and his warbraves are defending Thunder Totem from the drogbar and their earthen furies.

A warlock trainer is an NPC that offers warlocks the opportunity to train abilities and reset their talent points. In addition to warlock trainers, some locations also hold demon trainers. Demon trainers offer warlocks the opportunity to randomly generate a new name for any of their primary demons at a cost of a time per minion. This is achieved by obliterating the existing minion, allowing the warlock to summon a new demon in its place. Prior to patch 3.0.2, demon trainers were actually vendors of grimoires, used for training demon pets. __NOTOC__ Warden Jodi Moonsong is a night elf located at Stars' Rest in the Dragonblight.

Wardens of the Chamber are drakonid guardians of the sanctums of the five flights in the Chamber of the Aspects situated directly below Wyrmrest Temple. There are ten guards present. Four of them in pairs are guarding the entrances to Ruby Sanctum and Obsidium Sanctum respectively, while the other six in pairs are focusing some sort of spell at what would be the gateways to the other dragonflights' Sanctums.

Warcraft Saga is a comic mini-series written by Chris Metzen and illustrated by Alex Horley, serialized exclusively in World of Warcraft: The Magazine beginning with Volume 2. This mini-series delves into the ancient history of the Warcraft universe, including its origins and the activities of the various powerful forces that shaped it, including the Titans and the Burning Legion. Only one issue was ever published due to the magazine's cancellation. However, Micky Neilson said that the story will continue. The Saga was reprinted to Annual 2015.

The Warforged Nightmare is a product of molten metal, raw fire and fevered dreams. This terrifying steed was crafted from cold, hardened steel and vengeful spirits by grandmaster smiths, and gives the owner the ability to place a Nightmarish Hitching Post. This mysterious artifact has the power to summon a Warforged Nightmare for every member of your war party strong enough to handle the reins and worthy enough to be given the honor. The next time you rally your comrades to mount up and earn their keep, charging into battle astride this mount will embolden your friends, send your foes slinking for cover, and unleash unbridled chaos upon your enemies!

The Warcraft film universe is an alternate, separate version of the main Warcraft universe. The movie lore is similar, but different. It was streamlined to be more accessible to the general public. Personalities of characters are the same with slightly changed backstories.
Warcraft Rumble Machines are arcade machines found in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar, in Stormwind Harbor of Stormwind City, and on the second floor of the Roasted Ram in Valdrakken.

Warcraft Rumble Gamers are standing next to the Warcraft Rumble Machine in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar, in Stormwind Harbor of Stormwind City, and on the second floor of the Roasted Ram in Valdrakken.

Warmasters are Drek'Thar's elite officers, most of whom reside in the Frostwolf Keep in Alterac Valley next to their general. The exceptions to these are Warmaster Laggrond and Warmaster Garrick. Tied to their general, Warmasters cannot be pulled separately from Drek'Thar. A warrior trainer is an NPC that offers warriors the opportunity to train abilities and reset their talent points. A general rule of-thumb in finding the local Warrior trainer is to search by the city's PvP Services. If not there, you may find them in a barracks or training yard.

Watcher Cutford is a human that can be found patrolling in Duskwood. In the aftermath of the Fourth War, Cutford is still alive and a member of the Night Watch, and he assisted Mathias Shaw and Flynn Fairwind to carry Commander Ladimore back to the Night Watch's office in Darkshire after she was attacked by a necromancer who attempted to overwhelm Duskwood with an army of undead by corrupting the :Torch of Holy Flame. He watched over the ailing commander while Flynn and Shaw were busy retrieving the torch and defeating the necromancer.
Watchman's Rise is a small area in western Drustvar. It contains the Watchman's Tower that overlooks the city of Corlain. The road to the mountains leads up to Bleak Hills Mine.
Wastewander Exterminators are humans located at the courtyard of the Obelisk of the Moon in Uldum during the Assault in Uldum. They are keeping the aqir from leaving the Chamber of the Moon.
Watchful Lightfly is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Wayfarer's Rest (or the Wayfarer's Rest Tavern), located between the Walk of Elders and The Bazaar, is one of two inns located inside the blood elf capital, Silvermoon City. Wayfarer's Rest Inn is host to Innkeeper Jovia; Sylann, a cooking trainer; Quelis, a cooking supplier; and Rarthein.
Water Powered is one of the four buffs necessary to earn the feat of strength .

The Weathered Parchment is a scroll located at the very top of Highmountain Peak, the highest point in all of Highmountain.

Weapons of Order is the monk class ability of the Kyrian Covenant. It's available to all monks who join the Kyrian. The Weathered Flying Machine is a flying machine located at K3 in the Storm Peaks. Roxi Ramrocket is found working on the machine.

Weaver Daavu is a centaur located in the Ohn'ahran Plains. He is one of the few surviving members of Clan Toghus, having been rescued from the village of Daruukhan after it was destroyed by Clan Nokhud. After he is rescued by Taivan and the player returns to Marukaai, he and the rest of the Toghus survivors can be found near the center of the city, being tended to for their injuries.

Weaver Sagaa is a centaur located in the Ohn'ahran Plains. She is one of the few surviving members of Clan Toghus, having been rescued from the village of Daruukhan after it was destroyed by Clan Nokhud. After she is rescued by Taivan and the player returns to Marukaai, she and the rest of the Toghus survivors can be found near the center of the city, being tended to for their injuries.

The Western Plaguelands are located in northern Lordaeron, wedged between Tirisfal Glades to the west, the Eastern Plaguelands to the east, and the Alterac Mountains to the south. It is filled with a smoky gray mist and the creatures here are blighted and sick, angrily attacking anyone who wanders too close with surprising ferocity. The land is also home to countless undead who infest the ruins of Andorhal, the four cauldron fields, and Sorrow Hill. It is located in the city of Orgrimmar, on a high ridge overlooking the Valley of Wisdom, accessed by a series of bridges from the Orgrimmar Skyway. Its Alliance counterpart is the Eastern Earthshrine in Stormwind City. The Earthshrine has portals to Tol Barad and to all of the new zones in Cataclysm. The Westersea is a sea that borders the western coast of the Townlong Steppes until merging with the South Seas. The island of Shan'ze Dao, and the islands that hold Sra'vess and the Niuzao Temple are located inside these waters.
The Western Spray are the two bigger islands southwest of the Toothy Shallows off the southwestern coast of Mechagon Island.

An island somewhere on Azeroth. An invading force of dark trolls swept this island like a plague not too long ago. Most of the furbolgs who once thrived here were slaughtered; the few survivors have scattered into hiding.
When Elekks Fly is an ability used by Trunks during a Pet Battle.

The White Bandit Mask is a cloth face covering that used to give a bonus to both strength and agility prior to patch 2.3. It now gives +11 Intellect and increases damage and healing done by magical spells and effects by up to 13.

Whirligigs are a type of flying machine built by the gnomes before the First War. Both it and gnomish sky-engines were considered suitable for scouting. It predates the gnomish flying machine model invented during the Second War.

The Whispering Forest is a large forest located within the mountains of western Tirisfal Glades, just west of Deathknell. It is accessible via flight or by druids with Glyph of One With Nature. The forest contains families of diseased stags, does and fawns, rats and one diseased bear (lvl 80-84). To the north is the lake Tyr's Fall. Next to the lake is a chair and some fishing gear and bait. This is possibly one of the many odd places that Nat Pagle has visited.
Who's The Best Elekk In The Whole World? is an ability used by the Elekk Plushie during a pet battle. This ability doesn't actually do anything at all.

The Whitewater Carp is a reputation reward; you must be with the Highmountain Tribe to purchase this item from Ransa Greyfeather in Highmountain for . The carp can be kicked around for a while, once placed.

The Whispering Reef is an Island Expedition in Battle for Azeroth. It is a forested island with night elven ruins. It is inhabited by makrura, murlocs, and naga. Gorlocs, saurok, ice trolls and pirates can also be found here.
Whistlebloom Drones are small wasps that fly around Whistlebloom Oasis in Vol'dun in groups. They can also spawn from destroying Loose Whistlebloom Hives and Whistlebloom Eggs.

The wicker constructs are created by the Heartsbane Coven from dead objects such as wood, flesh, fur and bones, and animated by ancient Drust death magic. They are powered by the souls of human victims or by the spirits of ancient Drust which are thus given physical forms. The witches of the coven control the wicker creatures with charms. The strongest charms are in the hearts of the wicker creatures, pulsing like heartbeats, and are used to anchor their spirits. Some of the souls are still aware that they are inside the golems. It is hard to tell where the bone parts of a wicker creature end and where the wood parts begin.

Wild Mushroom: Plague was the Symbiosis ability granted to Frost and Unholy Death knights when they were the target of a Druid's Symbiosis spell. This was a modified combination of the Balance Druid abilities Wild Mushroom and Wild Mushroom: Detonate.
Wild Magic is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Wild Strength was a pet ability available exclusively to the clefthoof family of hunter pets, increasing player Versatility by 3% and multistrike chance by 5%.
Wild Mooncallers are worgen who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.

__NOTOC__ Wild Spirits is the hunter class ability of the Night Fae Covenant. It's available to all hunters who join the Night Fae. This ability is also temporarily available during the Ardenweald portion of the Shadowlands campaign; it's given by the quest Preparing for the Winter Queen and lasts until you finish the Ardenweald storyline.
William Montague is a Forsaken banker located in the Trade Quarter in the Undercity. He was present during the Battle for Lordaeron and could be evacuated out of the Undercity.

Wildwind Peak is the large and very tall mountain on Azuremyst Isle that the Exodar crashed into. During draenei shaman's questline Call of Air, they come up here to talk to Susurrus, the lord of air elementals in the region. The path to the summit is on the edge of the shore, somewhat hidden. At the top of the mountain there is a small cave occupied by Velaada, a draenei shaman and quest giver.
Wildhammer Gryphon Riders are Wildhammer dwarves quest givers located in Shadowmoon Valley. They are summonable using Wildhammer Flare Gun. Others are found flying around Wildhammer Stronghold.

Wildhammer clan dwarves have a new home in Kalimdor. It is located south of Mount Hyjal, in the peaks of the southern mountains within Ashenvale. Wildmoon is a moonkin appearing in series 4 of DC Direct's World of Warcraft action figures.

Wildhammer Mercenaries are Wildhammer dwarves located at the Battlescar in the Southern Barrens. They were hired by the Alliance to secure Fort Triumph and are believed to have destroyed Camp Taurajo. They fly on Triumph War Gryphons and wield stormhammers.

__NOTOC__ Wildswalker Nightborne are nightborne located at the Orgrimmar Embassy in Orgrimmar, and some of them can be seen leaving to Northern Barrens through the Talon Gate. Some of them randomly wander around Orgrimmar. They also appear in Silvermoon City and the Nighthold.

Wind Trader Zhareem is a ethereal and quest giver located in the Lower City of Shattrath. Zhareem can be found in the eastern part of Lower City, near the inn. He stands next to Nether-Stalker Mah'duun. Although Zhareem is a merchant by trait, his in-game NPC does not sell anything. His purpose is to give out daily quests for dungeons in heroic difficulty. Each day he offers one random quest of those below. An image of the final boss of the relevant dungeon is next to him. Between the pre-expansion patch of Mists of Pandaria and the end of Warlords of Draenor the quests were deactivated, but quietly reactivated by the time of the Legion pre-expansion patch.

Wind Trader Mu'fah is the ambassador to the blue dragonflight sent by the Ethereum, who plans to align with them. He is found in Moonrest Gardens in the Dragonblight. Mu'fah is waiting for an audience with Goramosh, but is delayed by one of his underlings, a Dragonblight Mage Hunter. It would appear that he has been there for awhile, as he threatens to call off the negotiations. Waiting greatly irritates him. In fact, when attacked, he seems more annoyed by the meeting being further delayed than by the attempt being made on his life. The details of Mu'fah's accord with the blue dragons would not be known for many years, until it was discovered during the third invasion of the Burning Legion

Windripper Peak is a mountain peak just above Skyhorn in Highmountain. The peak is where The Skyhorn, a large horn, can be found.

__NOTOC__ Winna's Kitten was a little house cat found alongside Winna Hazzard in Felwood. Winna had her kitten used as a test subject of the effects of water from a corrupted moonwell during Well of Corruption. The corrupted moonwell transformed the kitten into the Corrupted Cat, which was later seen as the Corrupted Saber.
Winter's Sisters are frost nymphs located at Star's Rest in the Dragonblight. They can be seen guarding the perimeter of the area along with Stars' Rest Sentinels.

Windshear Hold is an Alliance town located in Windshear Crag, Stonetalon Mountains. While using night elf architecture, it features many different Alliance races. It holds flight paths to Stardust Spire, Thal'darah Overlook, Farwatcher's Glen, and Nijel's Point.

The Winter Elderhorn is a white moose that can be found wandering around near Hark Sharpeye's hut west of Thunder Totem in Highmountain. During the Feast of Winter Veil, two Winter Elderhorns are the ones pulling Greatfather Winter's sled down Highmountain Peak.
Winifred Kerwin is Forsaken located in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity. Alongside Adrian Bartlett and Victor Bartholomew, she's attending at a lesson about demons by Jezelle Pruitt.
Wing Guard Buurkin is a gladiator flight master located at the Bleak Redoubt in Maldraxxus. His flight point is only available to Necrolord players.

Windsage Tohr is a centaur located at the Ohn'ir pools in Maruukai in the Ohn'ahran Plains. She is maintaining an orb of wind magic that she moves back and forth over the ground while Initiate Okan trains at hitting it with bolts of his own magic.

Witch Doctor Uzer'i is a jungle troll quest giver located at Camp Mojache in Feralas. He can often be seen dabbling in arcane alchemical formulae and is in close cooperation with Xerash Fireblade at Lariss Pavilion. Uzer'i is working on a potion developed to tap the power of the muisek - the spirits of creatures. According to him, night elves have long used the powers in the creatures of the land and it is time that the Horde be granted access to it, too. However, interested adventurers are likely to be asked to run a number of errands for this eccentric Witch Doctor before they are allowed to discover his true intentions.
Witches Band is an ring. It gives bonuess to stamina, intellect, spell power, and mana regeneration.

Witchdoctor Yoksa is a skeletal troll channeling next to a cauldron inside a small building in the northwestern Port of Zem'lan in Vol'dun. During The Yard Arm of the Law, Jukanga the Snitch can be seen hanging above Yoksa's cauldron. According to Zem'lan's Bloody Notes, after First Mate Jamboya found three powerful cursed idols, Yoksa believed that he could use the objects to perform a powerful ritual and planned to test them on one of the refugees in the port. It is not stated exactly what happened next, but the results were apparently even better than Pirate-King Zem'lan expected, leading to Zem'lan conducting the ritual that turned his entire crew into undead skeletons.

The Wormwing are a group of bright-plumaged harpies found residing near the Shrine of Aviana on the Rim of the World in Mount Hyjal. The Wormwing harpies, led by Marion Wormwing, were a peaceful group that lived among the Druids of the Talon and other winged creatures at the Shrine of Aviana in Mount Hyjal. Now working with Sethria and the Black dragonflight, they seek to destroy it all and even prevent Aviana's rebirth. After their leader is dealt with, this group of harpies either leave or have been wiped out, it's unclear which.

Wounded Marines are wounded Alliance marines found at the Shattered Beachhead of Shattershore in the Blasted Lands. They have sustained injuries as a result of fighting with Iron Horde forces in the region. They are attended to by "Stitches" Solderbolt.

Wounded Mountaineers are dwarven mountaineers that can be found at Kharanos in Dun Morogh. During Legion Invasions, they could be found injured by demons. Saving them would improve the score of defense against the Legion. Only Alliance adventurers could rescue them.
